headline: Show approved Jewel Brook campaign artwork with an external GitHub releases link

changes.title: Add linked Jewel Brook campaign banner to Nut Buster home
changes.detail: Restore the home promotional slot using the exact approved Jewel Brook wide WebP from its renamed repository. Tap to view Jewel Brook GitHub releases; Android and Fire OS hand the fixed link to an external browser, including prereleases.

changes.title: Retire the Rupee Rush coming-soon banner
changes.detail: Remove the obsolete coming-soon advert and its styling, retain release news and home navigation, add a regression guard, and record an explicit Android/Fire OS versus native Windows/Linux parity review. Desktop has no corresponding advert and existing native gameplay gaps remain unchanged.

changes.title: Require setup moves to repay their daily-move opportunity cost
changes.detail: The first exact-engine benchmark exercised 37 setup moves but revealed a Chapter 3 regression. The diagnostic planner now penalizes nonmatching actions, conditionally explores them, and compares them with a same-horizon match-only alternative before choosing.

changes.title: Correct planner report assertion and document the experimental regression
changes.detail: The report-only integration test now matches the actual report heading rather than an obsolete phrase. The diagnostic documentation records the measured regression, the candidate count, and the reasons for cautious setup selection.
